sentences.text: Antarctaspis is an extinct genus of arthrodire placoderm fish known only from a single species.
The type species Antarctaspis mcmurdoensis was described by White in 1968.
Antarctaspis belongs to the family Antarctaspididae.
It is classified within the class Placodermi.
Scientists consider it one of the most basal members of the order Arthrodira and note it is closely related to the genus Yujiangolepis.
This fish lived in Antarctica during the Givetian age of the Devonian period.
The genus existed from 410.62 to 382.31 million years ago, spanning the Emsian to Givetian stages.
